settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer:
It depends on the type of product:

  • Ready-to-ship products are regularly stocked and usually arrive in 7–10 business days.
  • Made-to-order products are crafted after you order, so delivery may take 25–30 days.

For the timeline of a specific product, call or WhatsApp our team.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
settings.answer:
Yes, on selected products. COD is available only for ready-to-ship products that are in stock and can be dispatched right away.

Made-to-order and custom products are built after the order is placed, so they need prepaid payment. Not sure if a product qualifies? Ask us before you order.

settings.question: Can I track my order?
settings.answer: Yes. Once your order is dispatched, you get a tracking number by email and WhatsApp. Use it on our Track Order page or on the courier partner’s website.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
We accept returns only for products that arrive damaged or defective. Contact our support team within the return request period and share clear photos of the problem.

Once approved, repack the product in its original packaging and send us photos of the packed item. We then arrange a pickup and help you with a replacement or other resolution.

Returns are not accepted for change of mind, wrong selection or personal preference.

settings.question: Do products come with a warranty?
settings.answer:
Yes, every product is covered.

  • 3-year manufacturing warranty for manufacturing defects and workmanship issues.
  • Lifetime termite warranty against termite damage.

For a claim, contact support with your order details.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer:
• Phone: +91-9785322576
  • WhatsApp: chat with our team
  • Email: info@furnisquare.com

Our team is available 24/7 for product questions, order updates, delivery information and warranty claims.

settings.question: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer: Yes, as long as it has not been dispatched. Once an order is in transit it can no longer be cancelled. Contact us with your order details as early as possible, or use the cancel order page.

settings.question: Do you provide GST invoices?
settings.answer: Yes. A GST-compliant invoice is sent to your registered email and included with your shipment.

settings.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
settings.answer: Yes, before the order ships. Contact support right away with your order number and the new address. After shipping, the address can’t be changed.

settings.question: Are installation or assembly services available?
settings.answer: Installation and assembly are not included by default. We may be able to arrange it on request, subject to availability in your area, and additional charges apply. Ask our team before or after you order.
